shared_elements: low-relief figures carved on upright pillar-like/vertical elements
possible schematic anthropomorphic figure in relief
flat plain field bordered by relief zones
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry shallow, schematic relief figures set on/against upright slab- or pillar-like faces, with large areas of undecorated flat field; in A the relief is confined to indistinct standing figure-like forms on narrow vertical projections. B by contrast presents a dense, ordered iconographic programme — a row of quadrupeds along the top, a banded net/zigzag pattern beneath, then birds, a long-necked bird in profile and serpentine/reptile forms stacked down the shaft — none of which is identifiable in A.
